evidence_scope: Retained results describe their pinned compiler and dependency versions. No timings are asserted to have been rerun on current main.

proof_track.policy: CI-built representative tactics and certificate replay; timings diagnostic, not a required verdict.

dependency_scope: Package and compiler changes are recorded as environment changes, not claimed runtime-neutral exemptions for new measurements. The retained evidence remains historical evidence at its exact pins.
closure_method: git diff --name-only base audited_revision intersected with recursive repository-local import closure of HexRank and both bench/HexRank source modules. Public/meta-only proof imports have no timed code. Additional upstream kernel modules considered separately are listed in runtime_audit.
